/* Opportunity narrow-phone 125% overflow correction -- CANDIDATE (experiment).
 *
 * Recorded separately from the immutable current-main HTML and injected at
 * runtime; the source bytes are never rewritten.
 *
 * Scope: the exact PRD-314 Opportunity selector, inside the same
 * @media(max-width:430px) block, reusing identical specificity so later
 * source order wins over the production rule. Nothing outside
 * #opportunity-survival .kv-grid is touched.
 *
 * Root cause: the two label tracks are `max-content`, so the widest label
 * (`PRIMARY REJECTION`, and `SETUPS FOUND` under operator lock) pins the grid
 * wider than the narrow phone as root text grows, producing 19-49px of page
 * overflow at 125%.
 *
 * Correction: swap the two `max-content` label tracks to `auto`. `auto` still
 * resolves to `max-content` when there is room (100% geometry unchanged), but
 * floors at min-content under pressure -- the two-word labels wrap at their
 * space (all text preserved, no truncation) while single-word labels stay
 * whole. The value tracks keep PRD-314's `minmax(2.5ch,1fr)` so 2-digit counts
 * never clip. No markup, DOM order, or text changes. */
@media (max-width: 430px) {
  #opportunity-survival .kv-grid {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(2.5ch, 1fr) auto minmax(2.5ch, 1fr);
  }
}
